description: Voice samples: add under consent, delete, read audio.
precondition: User with consent; speech worker replaced.

preconditions: User consented to notice "1.3" and keeps two own samples.
Audio holds 20 seconds of one clear voice.
cases.inputs: actorId: a consented user; audio: a clear voice recording; contentType: audio/mpeg.
cases.return: Success with the new sample (MSG307 "Đã lưu giọng mẫu."); only the encrypted vector is kept for matching, the recording under a consent that says so.
cases.log: Saved: encrypted sample with the model and speech length; audit row records the new sample.

cases.inputs: actorId: a user without consent; audio: a clear voice recording; contentType: audio/mpeg.
cases.return: Failure NoConsent (MSG308 "Cần đồng ý nhận diện giọng nói trước khi ghi giọng mẫu."); the audio never goes to the worker.

preconditions: User consented and already keeps 5 own samples.
cases.inputs: actorId: a user with 5 own samples; audio: a clear voice recording; contentType: audio/mpeg.
cases.return: Failure LimitReached (MSG310 "Đã đủ 5 giọng mẫu. Xoá bớt rồi ghi lại."); nothing is kept.

preconditions: User consented and keeps 4 own samples.
cases.inputs: actorId: a user with 4 own samples; audio: a clear voice recording; contentType: audio/mpeg.
cases.return: Success (MSG307); the 5th sample is stored, a 6th would be refused.
cases.log: Saved: encrypted sample; audit row records the new sample.
